//: Story Phase 9 crew dialogue: the morning after (who slept; nobody), the lecture (whispered asides from the floor and the hammocks), the council, the landing, the island (each of the landing party at a landmark), the dig (their shares), the run, the storm, the aftermath, the shanty (the captain was doing the voices), and after (Pete's title, Bob's tavern, Gristle's porch, Jim's fire, Ned's view, the Grand Stenchmaster behind a palm, a promise to Squawks).
pete.p9_post_1: pete[tired]: The Grand Sharkmaster has nothing to report. The Grand Sharkmaster has resigned. The Grand Sharkmaster has been told his resignation is 'not on file'.
pete.p9_post_2: pete: My little ship. With the bell. It's up there now, Captain. Going round. On a shark.
pete.p9_post_3: pete[annoyed]: A JEWELLED SHARK ECONOMY. That's what we've got now. I said it out loud and it's still true.
pete.p9_shanty: pete: (quietly) Are you all right, Captain? You were singing at a fish.
pete.p9_after: pete[tired]: It worked, Captain. For about four seconds, it worked.
pete.p9_storm: pete: It's raining sharks. It's actually raining SHARKS.
pete.p9_run: pete[alarmed]: Don't talk to me, Captain. Talk to the WALL. Make it thicker.
pete.p9_dig: pete: A ship. A little one. I keep thinking about the bell.
pete.p9_isle_1: pete: Look at 'em. Going round the reef like a merry-go-round. That decoy's still out there somewhere with an escort.
pete.p9_isle_2: pete[annoyed]: Garrick keeps calling across the beach. 'Grand Sharkmaster, status report!' My status is: no.
pete.p9_deck: pete[annoyed]: I'm watching the fins because it's a good idea, Captain. Not because it's my JOB.
pete.p9_council_2: pete[annoyed]: It's not a class, Captain. Tell me it's not a class. I'm still a deckhand. I'm still PETE.
pete.p9_lecture_1: pete: (whispering) 'Resting is sleeping with your eyes open.' I'm going to be thinking about that for the rest of my life.
pete.p9_lecture_2: pete: (whispering) A FART SASH. In his OWN story. I'll never be this happy again.
pete.p9_morning: pete[tired]: Rope. Everywhere. In my dreams, Captain. In my SOUL.
bob.p9_post_1: bob: No fish pies today, Captain. Maybe some day. I'm keeping the sign in my head.
bob.p9_post_2: bob: The fish in this river nibble. I've accepted it. We have an understanding.
bob.p9_shanty: bob: Captain, you were doing all the voices. Even the hammerhead.
bob.p9_after: bob[sad]: I'd have called it the Barnacle. With a sign. A barnacle on it.
bob.p9_storm: bob: They're COMMUNICATING, Captain. I heard them. WHOOSH. BLOORP.
bob.p9_run: bob[alarmed]: Sharks that way! Garrick that way! WHICH WAY IS AWAY?
bob.p9_dig: bob: The Barnacle. Fish pies. A proper bed. I can SEE it, Captain.
bob.p9_isle_1: bob: There's fish in the river, Captain, and they NIBBLE. Little nibbles. I don't know what they want from me.
bob.p9_isle_2: bob: The water's warm. Do you think there's eels? Gristle says there's eels.
bob.p9_deck: bob: I'll row, Captain. I've got good arms. I've got terrible everything else, but good arms.
bob.p9_council: bob: I saw it first! ...No, Ned saw it first. I saw it second. I'm still counting that.
bob.p9_morning: bob: I've got squares on my face, Captain. From the net. I'm a draughts board.
gristle.p9_post_1: gristle: The shelter held. That's something. The shelter held, and the sharks are wearing our pension.
gristle.p9_post_2: gristle: A porch that doesn't move. Some day. I'll sit on it and I won't get up for a storm. Even this one.
gristle.p9_shanty: gristle: You were very loud, Captain. The fish weren't. Just so you know.
gristle.p9_after: gristle[concerned]: Seven floors. He went through all seven. And the treasure. And the sky.
gristle.p9_storm: gristle[annoyed]: They are NOT communicating. I won't have it.
gristle.p9_run: gristle[annoyed]: That gap wants a stone in it, Captain, not a conversation.
gristle.p9_dig: gristle: Seven floors. Somebody really didn't want this found.
gristle.p9_isle: gristle: The broken tooth. Just like the map. Whoever drew that map had been here, Captain. Stood right here.
gristle.p9_deck: gristle: Lines are lines, Captain. Make 'em fast, keep 'em fast. Easiest job on this ship.
gristle.p9_council: gristle: Lee side's right. The cliffs'll take the wind. Pete's not stupid, he's just furious.
gristle.p9_lecture_1: gristle: (whispering) Lady Windbottom. He's got her in a moustache, Captain. HIS moustache.
gristle.p9_morning: gristle[annoyed]: Nine hundred and twelve snores. I'm going to have that number on my gravestone.
jim.p9_post_1: jim: There's a coconut here the size of my head, Captain, and nobody has been near it. It's beautiful.
jim.p9_post_2: jim: I've got the fire going on the beach. Fish and fruit. No bowl. He's still got my bowl.
jim.p9_shanty: jim: For what it's worth, Captain, the tune was catchy. I hate that it was catchy.
jim.p9_after: jim[sad]: I was going to put a lock on the lock.
jim.p9_storm: jim: There's a shark in the yard, Captain. A whole one. On the GRASS.
jim.p9_run: jim[angry]: Seventy per cent of WHAT? What's the other thirty?
jim.p9_dig: jim[happy]: A kitchen. With a lock. And my BOWL in it.
jim.p9_isle_1: jim[happy]: Fruit, Captain! Real fruit! On a tree! Nobody's breathed on it!
jim.p9_isle_2: jim: I'm keeping the good ones away from you-know-who. He's already had a 'ceremonial taste' of three.
jim.p9_deck: jim[disgusted]: I'm not touching the timber, Captain. I'm not looking at the timber. I'm not THINKING about the timber.
jim.p9_council: jim: Whatever we do, Captain, the biscuits come with us. Sealed. In wax. Away from HIM.
jim.p9_lecture_1: jim[angry]: My bowl. My MIXING BOWL. I want it back, and I want it back un-grand.
jim.p9_morning: jim[disgusted]: It's in the BUTTER, Captain. The butter we HAVEN'T GOT.
ned.p9_post_1: ned: From up here you can see it go round. Every turn, something flashes. Coins. A crown. It's our money, waving.
ned.p9_post_2: ned: It's not coming in to the island any more. It stands off. Waiting for the next smell, I reckon.
ned.p9_shanty: ned: You were singing the hammerhead's bit, Captain. In a hammerhead voice.
ned.p9_after: ned: The crown went on the megalodon, Captain. I watched it all the way down. It didn't miss.
ned.p9_storm: ned: That shadow. Captain, that shadow's too big. That shadow's the size of the SHIP.
ned.p9_run: ned[alarmed]: The storm's turned, Captain. It's looking at the clearing. Storms don't look. It's LOOKING.
ned.p9_dig: ned: A little house. Up a hill. Where the wind blows the other way.
ned.p9_isle_1: ned[smug]: You can see the whole sea from here, Captain. The Revenge. The reef. The storm, standing off. It can't get in.
ned.p9_isle_2: ned: Thank you for letting me look round, Captain. A whole island. I've never stood on one that wasn't sinking.
ned.p9_deck: ned: Fins thinning on the starboard side, Captain. Not thin enough yet. Ask Pete. Don't tell him I said ask him.
ned.p9_council: ned: Crowned skull, Captain. Like it was carved. I don't think it was carved. I think it just grew like that, out of spite.
ned.p9_lecture_1: ned: (whispering) Seven ships, and the seventh sank from embarrassment. I've been at sea forty years. Never seen a ship blush.
ned.p9_morning: ned: Something out there, Captain. The light's different through the crack. Greener.
hale.p9_post: hale: Log entry: 'Treasure found. Treasure lost. Treasure now in the weather.' I've never written that before.
hale.p9_deck: hale: Good luck, Captain. We'll keep her off the reef. Bring us back something shiny.
hale.p9_council: hale[concerned]: The boats are small, Captain. And wooden. And DELICIOUS.
hale.p9_lecture: hale: I'm writing it all down, Captain. In a separate column. Headed 'HE SAID'.
hale.p9_morning: hale[resigned]: Log entry: 'Nobody slept. The Grand Stenchmaster slept.' Underlined.
wick.p9_council: wick: (from his hammock) An island? With a laundry?
wick.p9_lecture: wick: (from his hammock) Wake me when it's the bit about the discount bin.
wick.p9_morning: wick[sad]: I fell out of my hammock, Captain. When you shook his. I was nearly asleep. NEARLY.
fennimore.p9_post: fennimore: I'll stay aboard, Captain. Someone has to be here when they come back with the injuries.
fennimore.p9_lecture: fennimore: (from his hammock) 'Resting'. I'm resting. Medically.
fennimore.p9_morning: fennimore[concerned]: As a doctor, Captain: nobody has slept. As a doctor, I'm going to go and lie down.
rook.p9_morning: rook[annoyed]: Forty-one planks over my head. Forty after that landing in the night.
sully.p9_post: sully: Holding her steady, Captain. The reef's right there. I'm not looking at it.
sully.p9_morning: sully[sad]: Morning, Captain. Is it? It's grey. Grey counts.
brask.p9_morning: brask: I dreamed I was a cannon. Somebody lit me. It was a nice dream until then.
jory.p9_morning: jory: Captain. I've been awake since the crown. The crown was hours ago.
nell.p9_post: nell: She's riding easy here, Captain. Lee of the island. Best anchorage we've had all month.
nell.p9_deck: nell: South of the reef's the lee, Captain. Out of the wind. You'll feel her settle.
nell.p9_morning: nell[concerned]: The wind's backed in the night, Captain. The sea's lying down a bit. Land's not far, I'd say.
finch.p9_morning: finch[sad]: Forty years at sea and I've never been puffed on in my sleep before. FWOoF. Like a bellows.
mags.p9_morning: mags[annoyed]: My grog mug's still under the drip. It's full of drip. I'm drinking it.
quill.p9_lecture: quill: (from his hammock) I'll need that bowl back on the inventory, Captain. Under 'galley', not 'treasures'.
quill.p9_morning: quill[sad]: I've inventoried the night, Captain. Forty-one FWOoFs. One crown. Zero sleep.
penhallow.p9_morning: penhallow: Is there tea, Captain? There isn't tea. I'll lie here and think about tea.
garrick.p9_post_1: garrick[nervous]: (from behind the palm) ...I'm a tree, Captain.
garrick.p9_post_2: garrick[nervous]: (from behind the palm) The excavation was a TECHNICAL success. The treasure is no longer underground.
garrick.p9_post_3: garrick[nervous]: (from behind the palm) Has the Grand Sharkmaster prepared a recovery plan? No? I'll wait. Here. Behind this tree.
garrick.p9_dig_1: garrick[worried]: Forty hours, Captain. It FELT like forty hours.
garrick.p9_dig_2: garrick[businesslike]: A small percentage. Purely ceremonial. No? No.
garrick.p9_isle_1: garrick[businesslike]: The Grand Stenchmaster requires a bridge.
captain: It's a ford, Garrick. You walk through it.
garrick.p9_isle_2: garrick[proud]: Formal dress, Captain. Every island deserves to meet a Grand Stenchmaster properly.
garrick.p9_deck: garrick[proud]: The Grand Stenchmaster is observing, Captain. Observation is a duty.
garrick.p9_council_1: garrick[proud]: The Grand Sharkmaster is doing very well, Captain. I'm drafting his first performance review.
garrick.p9_council_2: garrick[businesslike]: A two-pack, Captain. It would have been wasteful not to appoint someone.
garrick.p9_lecture_1: garrick[proud]: Any further questions, Captain? I have materials.
